items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995

ctx.x: That’s right, that’s the truth. And so we’re going to wrap up this interview at this time, and it’s been wonderful having Buddy Tate with us and Georgette, and
Who we didn’t get on camera, yes, and we’re going to continue to do these interviews over a period of time, and hopefully make a difference in the cultural life of America.
